scope: Only the cross-author exact-repeat session/client delta and focused regression tests; no review of my own bandwidth-profile implementation.
observed: Full input-slice equality includes exact length and bytes; cached identity comes from the module-private immutable acknowledged base, not caller-supplied hashes.
Context and resource admission precede equality and exchange. Policy/execution namespace changes discard scoped readiness.

Every exact repeat sends a fresh Raw Begin alone and requires current reply transfer/sequence/object checks in the unchanged BatchSender. Receiver eviction continues the same Raw offer with the exact owned bytes and Finish.
Failed exchange invalidates receiver readiness; no new retry, wire mode, receiver authorization bypass or weakened publication verification is introduced.
Nonrepeat codec selection remains unchanged. Selection receipts explicitly report only Raw miss cost, not a minimum over skipped codecs.
Retained behavioral RED fails Begin-only assertion (3 frames vs1); focused GREEN reports9passed/1ignored. Eviction, stopped-store exact readback, invalid ACK and scope regressions are present.
limitations: No new builds or benchmarks were run by this reviewer. Test receipts were inspected; root owns final integrated validation.
Sender diagnostic acknowledgements are test-generated and do not establish actual MVM/WAN latency, authentication performance or physical energy. Actual guest campaign remains pending.
The helper still uses existing HTTP-body cost accounting; this is not a claim of globally minimal canonical-envelope bytes.
